connector.name: Agent Droid Bridge
connector.registryDescription: MCP server giving AI agents eyes and hands inside Android devices via ADB
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package agent-droid-bridge. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the neverlow512 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: ADB_EXECUTION_MODE
env.description: Security mode. 'unrestricted' allows all shell commands with an optional denylist. 'restricted' allows only commands in ADB_SHELL_ALLOWLIST.

env.name: ADB_ALLOW_SHELL
env.description: Set to 'false' to block all adb shell commands regardless of execution mode.

env.name: ADB_PATH
env.description: Path to the ADB binary. Use a full path if adb is not on your system PATH.

env.name: ADB_EXTRA_TOOL_PACKS
env.description: Comma-separated list of extra tool packs to load. Set to 'app_manager' to enable 9 additional app management tools.

env.name: ADB_DENIED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated list of tool names to hide from the agent at startup.

env.name: ADB_SHELL_ALLOWLIST
env.description: Comma-separated list of shell commands permitted in restricted mode. Empty blocks all shell commands.

env.name: ADB_SHELL_DENYLIST
env.description: Comma-separated list of shell commands blocked in unrestricted mode.

env.name: MCP_LOG_ENABLED
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable session logging. Requires MCP_LOG_DIR.

env.name: MCP_LOG_DIR
env.description: Absolute path to the directory where session logs are written. Required when MCP_LOG_ENABLED is true.

env.name: ADB_COMMAND_TIMEOUT
env.description: Maximum seconds to wait for any ADB command.

env.name: ADB_SCREENSHOT_TIMEOUT
env.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a screenshot capture.

env.name: ADB_UI_CHANGE_TIMEOUT
env.description: Default timeout in seconds for detect_ui_change.

env.name: ADB_UI_CHANGE_POLL_INTERVAL
env.description: How often in seconds detect_ui_change polls the UI hierarchy.

env.name: ADB_AAPT_TIMEOUT
env.description: Maximum seconds to wait for aapt dump badging, used by the app_manager pack.

env.name: ADB_CONFIG_SOURCE
env.description: Set to 'yaml' to load configuration from adb_config.yaml instead of environment variables.
